第一个师傅
“问天楼！
五音亭！”
听着龙啸口中这些江湖大势力的名字，隋缘眼中不由得有些神往，“这些势力，究竟有多厉害？”
“超出你想象的厉害。”
青衣道长的声音从后面传来，龙啸偏头一看，却见老道士不知何时已经站在了隋缘的身旁。
“道长。”
龙啸恭谨的向老道士行了一礼，将手中烤的焦黄的鱼递了上去。
青衣道长点了点头，接了龙啸递上来的烤鱼在两人身旁坐下，边吃边说到，“五音亭、知音斋、问天楼、入世阁、听香榭，世人都传这五大势力乃是这天下灭亡的皇室遗民所创，事实上也确实如此。”
老道士一语道破天机，确实听得一旁得龙啸有些震惊。
江湖上纷纷扰扰的争论了数百年的事情，没想到这老道士却是如此肯定，不过想到这老道士的身份，心中又有些释然了。
“前朝遗民！
？”
隋缘自语了一句，虽有些震惊，却是不如一旁的龙啸来的剧烈。
“不知道之前的大齐皇室建立的又是哪一家势力？”
隋缘轻声自语道。
“他们没能留下任何势力，”
青衣道长说到，“或许有些幸运的侥幸活了下来，在某个地方躲着当富家翁，但若说到江湖势力，”
摇了摇头，老道士似是有些感慨，“自从三百年前魏国皇室建立了听香榭后，江湖上五方势力便彻底稳定了下来，之后朝代更迭若想染指江湖，这五家的人便会共同出手扼杀。”

“这是为何？”
隋缘闻言有些惊讶，“难道只因为这五大势力建立的最早么？”
“这也是一个原因，”
老道士点头道，“建立的早，根深蒂固，自然占些优势，但要说到真正的原因，”
老道士将手中吃剩的鱼头丢进面前的火堆，轻笑道，“这其中涉及到更深层次的东西，你现在没必要问的太多，该是你知道的时候，你自然会明白。”
看着面前老道士似笑非笑的模样，隋缘有些懵懂的点了点头。
一旁的龙啸只是静静的听着两人的谈话，大气都不敢喘一口，如此江湖秘闻，自己以前可以接触不到的。
“接下来有什么打算？”
看着面前的隋缘，老道士有些随意的问道。
“没什么打算，“隋缘摇了摇头，”
我自小在平川城长大，现在得罪了城里的大势力，平川城是回不去了，如今只能走到哪里算哪里！
“你如果想回去也可以，“老道士摇了摇头，”
我在江湖上还算有些名声，大大小小的势力应该也能说得上话，你如果愿意，我可以替你去说情。
老道士连隋缘得罪的是哪一家势力、是因为什么原因得罪的都没有问便大包大揽了下来，隋缘没有察觉到这其中有什么不对，一旁的龙啸也是一副理当如此的模样。
“不必了，“想到平川城城主府的人，隋缘摇了摇头，”

first master
“Wentian Tower!
Wuyin Pavilion! "
Listening to the names of these powerful forces in the world from Long Xiao's mouth, Sui Yuan couldn't help but be fascinated, "How powerful are these forces?"
"More than you think."
The voice of Taoist Priest Qingyi came from behind. Long Xiao turned his head and saw that the old Taoist priest had already stood beside Sui Yuan at some point.
"Taoist Master."
Long Xiao bowed respectfully to the old Taoist priest and handed over the roasted fish in his hand.
Taoist Priest Qingyi nodded, took the grilled fish handed over by Long Xiao and sat down next to the two of them. While eating, he said, "Wuyin Pavilion, Zhiyinzhai, Wentian Tower, Rushi Pavilion, and Tingxiang Elysées. It is said that these five great powers were created by the remnants of the imperial family that perished in this world. In fact, it is true."
The old Taoist priest revealed the secret, and Long Xiao was indeed a little shocked when he heard it.
The world has been arguing about this matter for hundreds of years, but I didn't expect this old Taoist priest to be so sure, but when I thought of the old Taoist priest's identity, I felt a little relieved.
"Remnants of the previous dynasty!
? "
Sui Yuan muttered to himself. Although he was a little shocked, it was not as violent as the dragon roaring beside him.
"I wonder which force was established by the previous Daqi royal family?"
Sui Yuan whispered to himself.
"They didn't leave any power behind,"
Taoist Priest Qingyi said, "Maybe some of you are lucky enough to survive and become rich men hiding somewhere, but when it comes to the power of the world,"
Shaking his head, the old Taoist priest seemed to be feeling a little emotional, "Since the Wei royal family established the Tingxiang Elysées three hundred years ago, the five forces in the world have been completely stabilized. After that, if the dynasties change and want to get involved in the world, the people from these five families will work together to kill it."
"Why?"
Sui Yuan was a little surprised when he heard this, "Is it just because these five major forces were established earliest?"
"That's also a reason,"
The old Taoist priest nodded and said, "It was established early and is deeply rooted, so it naturally has some advantages, but when it comes to the real reason,"
The old Taoist priest threw the leftover fish head in his hand into the fire in front of him and said with a chuckle, "This involves something deeper. You don't need to ask too many questions now. When it's time for you to know, you will naturally understand."
Seeing the old Taoist priest in front of him smiling but not smiling, Sui Yuan nodded in confusion.
Long Xiao on the side just listened quietly to the conversation between the two, not daring to take a breath. He had never been able to access such secrets of the world before.
"What are your plans next?"
Looking at Sui Yuan in front of him, the old Taoist priest asked casually.
"No plans," Sui Yuan shook his head, "
I grew up in Pingchuan City. Now I have offended the big forces in the city. I can't go back to Pingchuan City. Now I can only go wherever I go!
"You can go back if you want," the old Taoist priest shook his head.
I have a certain reputation in the world, and I should be able to speak to various forces big and small. If you are willing, I can intercede on your behalf.
The old Taoist priest didn't even ask which power Sui Yuan had offended and for what reason, and he took them all in. Sui Yuan didn't notice anything wrong with this, and Long Xiao on the side also looked like it was natural.
"No need," Sui Yuan shook his head, thinking of the people in the Lord's Mansion of Pingchuan City.
